facts.why: Stock year under 'Now showing above the counter' prints the release year on a 1964 Erie diner card, so it reads as the diner's year. The film is set in 1964.

notes: Spartacus line, Villapiano's bonus on the bar, 'Erie's lone beatnik' (Chad, as Guy walks in), 'The one-hit Wonders' (Mr. White) verbatim on Wikiquote. Oh-Needers, pizza parlor gig, number 7, Shades, Del Paxton on Wikipedia. 'Spaghetti place out by the airport' and the red booths on I Am Not A Stalker. Menu still: the band on a stage with curtains; the caption 'The band on stage, guitars up.' describes it and claims no venue, so it is ok. Second still (band and Faye at the tour bus) has no caption. Winks are not printed on this layout.

vibe.verdict: Villapiano's red-booth Italian menu with the bonus, Spartacus and the one-hit Wonders feels like 1964 Erie, but the logo box repeats the poster and most of the film's big moments stay off the page.
